description: The bar chart compares the performance of two text-to-SQL models, TA-SQL and DIN-SQL, across three evaluation metrics: Recall, Precision, and F1 Score. The horizontal axis displays the metrics, while the vertical axis represents the score value, ranging from 40 to 100. Each metric has three bars representing different experimental conditions: a gray bar for the zero-shot baseline, a blue bar for TA-SQL in the zero-shot setting, and a light green bar for DIN-SQL in the few-shot setting. For Recall, the zero-shot baseline achieves a score of 63.58, TA-SQL (zero-shot) scores 71.90, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) scores 72.29. In Precision, the baseline is 88.89, TA-SQL (zero-shot) is 91.24, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) is 92.31. For F1 Score, the baseline is 75.34, TA-SQL (zero-shot) is 80.40, and DIN-SQL (few-shot) is 81.08. The chart shows that DIN-SQL (few-shot) consistently achieves the highest score in all three metrics, followed by TA-SQL (zero-shot), with the zero-shot baseline being the lowest.
